definitions.title: The Natural Exponential Function e^x
definitions.statement: The natural exponential function exp(x) = e^x is the inverse of the natural logarithm function. It is its own derivative: d/dx[e^x] = e^x.
definitions.explanation: Because e^x is its own derivative, it models natural growth and decay processes where the rate of change is proportional to current size.
definitions.keyTakeaway: e^x is the unique non-trivial real function that equals its own derivative.
